steps.en: Leaving a required field empty shows an error list
steps.id: Field wajib yang kosong memunculkan daftar error

steps.en: A wrong or future offence date or time is refused
steps.id: Tanggal atau jam offence yang salah atau di masa depan ditolak

steps.en: Vehicle number format and field lengths are checked
steps.id: Format nomor kendaraan dan panjang field dicek

steps.en: A rule code or fine amount not from the list is refused
steps.id: Rule code atau denda yang bukan dari list ditolak

steps.en: A car park picked from the list is checked, but free-typed 'Other' is not
steps.id: Car park dari list dicek, tetapi 'Other' yang diketik bebas tidak
steps.why_en: Choosing 'Other' lets the officer type any car park code without checking it against the car park list.
steps.why_id: Memilih 'Other' membuat officer bisa mengetik kode car park apa pun tanpa dicek ke daftar car park.

steps.en: The system rechecks only some of the entered data
steps.id: Sistem hanya mengecek ulang sebagian data yang diisi
steps.why_en: Only required fields and the rule code are rechecked; car park, fine amount and vehicle number format are not.
steps.why_id: Hanya field wajib dan rule code yang dicek ulang; car park, jumlah denda, dan format nomor kendaraan tidak.
